name: @pipeworx/mcp-jokes

tools.name: get_joke
tools.description: Get a random joke, optionally filtered by category (e.g., 'general', 'programming') or type ('single' or 'twopart'). Returns joke text, category, and content flags.

category.description: Joke category. One of: Any, Programming, Misc, Dark, Pun, Spooky, Christmas. Defaults to "Any".

type.description: Joke type. One of: single, twopart. Omit to allow either type.

safe_mode.description: When true, only return jokes that are flagged safe by JokeAPI. Defaults to true.

tools.name: search_jokes
tools.description: Search jokes by keyword or phrase. Returns matching jokes with categories, types, and content flags.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for within joke text.

category.description: Limit search to a category. One of: Any, Programming, Misc, Dark, Pun, Spooky, Christmas. Defaults to "Any".

amount.description: Number of jokes to return. Defaults to 5.

safe_mode.description: When true (the default), only return jokes JokeAPI flags as safe. Set false to include Dark and other unsafe-flagged categories.

tools.name: get_joke_categories
tools.description: List all available JokeAPI joke categories (e.g., Programming, Misc, Dark, Pun, Spooky, Christmas). Use the returned category names as the category input to get_joke or search_jokes.

tools.name: get_joke_flags
tools.description: List all content filter flags (e.g., explicit, political, racist). Use to understand what filters exclude.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-jokes forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the jokes pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
